# One row per function of the target executable: address, size, name.
# Boundaries from the compiler's unwind tables (.eh_frame), plus the
# functions without one that a live reference reaches (commented rows,
# config/residue.<slug>.txt, docs/DECISIONS.md D13), written by
# tools/survey_elf.py, which keeps a row's name once it is no longer
# FUN_<addr>. A name is a fact of the executable (an exported symbol, a
# reflection or type-info string with the role the vtable or the ABI
# fixes); anything inferred stays FUN_<addr> with a derived name in the
# source (docs/MATCH.md).
